x: The Jagannath temple at Puri (c. 57-65 m) is the largest and tallest surviving temple of Odisha; Lingaraj (c. 55 m) is the largest in Bhubaneswar (official/books key: Lingaraj).
source: Odisha Review, Jun-Jul 2018 p.110-129 (ASI: 57.28 m, largest and tallest surviving temple of Odisha)
evidence: visit.bhubaneswar.me (Lingaraj 180 ft, surpassed only by Jagannath)
dispute: Most books and the official key give the Lingaraj temple (the largest temple of Bhubaneswar). Strictly, Odisha Review (citing ASI) calls the Jagannath temple at Puri the largest and tallest surviving temple in Odisha.
